name: Security Check Before Commit
description: Validate security requirements before code is committed

then.prompt:
Security validation checklist before committing:

**Mandatory Checks:**
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens)
- [ ] All user inputs validated before processing
- [ ] SQL injection prevention (parameterized queries)
- [ ] XSS prevention (sanitized HTML)
- [ ] CSRF protection enabled
- [ ] Authentication/authorization verified
- [ ] Rate limiting on all endpoints
- [ ] Error messages don't leak sensitive data

**Dart/Flutter Specific:**
- [ ] Secrets in flutter_secure_storage, not SharedPreferences
- [ ] HTTPS enforced for all API calls
- [ ] Deep links validated before navigation
- [ ] WebView JavaScript disabled unless required
- [ ] Android components not exported unnecessarily
- [ ] iOS Keychain used for sensitive data

**If any check fails:**
1. STOP immediately
2. Fix CRITICAL issues before continuing
3. Rotate any exposed secrets
4. Review entire codebase for similar issues

Reference: .kiro/steering/common/security-checklist.md and .kiro/steering/dart/dart-security.md
